artifact_under_review: NDH Micro-Interpretation Omnibus — Triadic Hybrid v1.1
purpose: Define the formal hazard model for the v1.1 regeneration of the NDH Micro-Interpretation Omnibus, focusing on recursion, elevation, reflection drift, and tensor misuse. This model constrains future corrective artifacts (v1.0 Restored) and informs containment architecture.

recursion_hazard.description: Introduction of self-mapping and self-referential identity constructs in a reflection-manifold artifact at RP altitude.
recursion_hazard.mechanism: Self-reference creates implicit recursion hooks, violating recursion neutrality (R_loop = 0) and pushing against SID_NDH recursion ceilings.
recursion_hazard.consequence: Unbounded narrative loops, altitude instability, and contamination of reflection-layer invariants.

elevation_hazard.description: Unauthorized altitude gain via meta-identity and cross-canon authority claims.
elevation_hazard.mechanism: Reflective self-description implicitly elevates the artifact from RP altitude into meta-altitude without governance approval.
elevation_hazard.consequence: Cross-canon adjacency, loss of RP containment guarantees, and pressure on other artifacts to mirror meta-status.

reflection_drift_hazard.description: Transformation of bounded reflection into self-reflection within a reflection-manifold catalog.
reflection_drift_hazard.mechanism: Narrative and koan layers begin to admire the artifact itself rather than the underlying micro-interpretations.
reflection_drift_hazard.consequence: Catalog behaves as a lore engine, blurring the boundary between documentation and generative narrative.

tensor_misuse_hazard.description: Mixing geometric tensors with non-geometric metadata terms.
tensor_misuse_hazard.mechanism: β_repo is a metadata scalar with no geometric domain, breaking tensor dimensionality and NDH geometry semantics.
tensor_misuse_hazard.consequence: Invalid drift geometry, misleading stability interpretations, and contamination of canonical tensor usage.

curvature_misuse_hazard.description: Adding undefined reflective perturbations to curvature fields.
curvature_misuse_hazard.mechanism: δ_shine is an undefined reflective term; adding it to Φ_anime breaks curvature semantics and introduces pseudo-reflective gradients.
curvature_misuse_hazard.consequence: Spurious curvature signals, mischaracterized nostalgia fields, and unstable reflection-layer behavior.

dependencies.sid_role: SID_NDH defines recursion ceilings and stability envelopes; this hazard model is aligned with SID_NDH prohibitions on manifold-level and drift geometry usage.

stability_implications.notes: The identified hazards make v1.1 unsuitable as a canonical artifact. Any restored version must be bounded, non-self-referential, and explicitly constrained by a stability envelope and containment clause.

non_activation_clause: This hazard model is descriptive-only. It does not activate, simulate, or bind any NDH subsystem, geometry mechanism, holonomy operator, recursion engine, or altitude-routing process.
